note: For every city the page can be down in: DIRT Earth's biome, realm, ecoregion and soil there, and the plants of that biome in that realm, stratum by stratum (name, crown shape, crown radius in DIRT cells, cover, plants). From DIRT's atlas and grammar of places; written by scripts/build_characters.py. places: [lat, lon, set, ecoregion, soil, key]: key, where the place has a character of its own, characters/places/<key>.json. natives: an artist's name -> the place they are the native of.

crowns.lobed: a broadleaf crown: a low dome swelling in five lobes and eight smaller ones
crowns.cone: a conifer seen from above: a steep point, bright on the sunward side, its skirts in shadow, star-edged with eight branches
crowns.umbrella: a flat-topped crown, broad and thin, crisp-edged, standing high on a bare trunk, so its shadow lies far from it: an acacia
crowns.palm: fronds radiating from a point: eight deep lobes
crowns.column: a column with almost no crown: a cactus or a quiver tree, all shadow
crowns.tussock: a clump of grass: a tiny, tight mound, many together
crowns.cushion: a cushion plant or dwarf shrub: a low, dense, rounded mat
crowns.rosette: a giant rosette on a stem: a star of thirteen leaves, as frailejones and giant lobelias
crowns.reed: reeds and papyrus in water: fine, dense, leaning with the wind
crowns.mangrove: a low, dense crown standing in water on its roots
